title: Agentic distributed systems 的 epistemic fault tolerance
statement: 當節點協議上誠實但 reasoning 錯誤且錯誤高度相關時，如何保證 semantic validity、agreement 與 liveness。
known_result: Honest Quorum/EBFT 2026 formalizes protocol-compliant agents forming invalid quorums under correlated epistemic faults。
open_gap: 如何從可測 calibration 得到可靠 fault budgets，並設計不只靠模型多樣性名義上的 quorum。
first_task: 先做 toy state-machine，模擬獨立與相關錯誤；重現普通 BFT 與 EBFT threshold 的差異。
evaluator: 精確 threshold checks、Monte Carlo coverage、adversarial correlated-error cases。
validation_limits: toy fault distribution 不代表部署世界；agreement 不是 semantic correctness。
completion_criterion: 在明列 fault model 下給出可檢查 safety/liveness conditions 並跨 error distributions 驗證。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查；不是完整全網未解證明。新輪次必須重新檢索並閱讀原始來源。
screening_queries: Honest Quorum epistemic Byzantine fault tolerance 2026

sources.title: The Honest Quorum Problem: Epistemic Byzantine Fault Tolerance for Agentic Infrastructure
sources.supports: agentic validators 的 correlated epistemic faults
